mainEntity.name: Which Jaguar XE engines can you work on?

acceptedAnswer.text: We work on XE 2.0 Ingenium diesel and petrol engines and the supercharged 3.0 V6 from the XE S, following an initial assessment.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Jaguar XE engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on the engine type, unit availability and labour involved. We provide a quote after assessing your XE rather than a set price.

mainEntity.name: Do you supply Jaguar XE reconditioned engines?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. When replacement is the better option, we can supply and fit a reconditioned engine matched to your XE's engine code.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between 204DTD and 204DTA?

acceptedAnswer.text: Both are 2.0 Ingenium diesels. The 204DTA is the twin-turbo, higher-output version, while the 204DTD is the single-turbo unit used in lower-powered models.

mainEntity.name: Does an engine rattle mean the timing chain has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not necessarily. A rattle can have several causes. An inspection is needed to confirm whether the timing chain or another component is responsible.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Jaguar XE engine rebuild take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timescales depend on the fault, parts availability and machining required. We will give you an estimated timeframe after the engine has been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Is there a Jaguar XE engine specialist near me?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our workshop is in Grays, Essex, and we offer UK-wide collection and delivery, so we can help wherever your XE is located.
